teaser: The Government of Canada is taking action to protect Canadian industries and strengthen the economy in a rapidly changing global trade environment. As economic security, industrial policy, and global economic competition increasingly shape investment, trade, and financial decisions, the Government of Canada is building the strongest economy in the G7 by moving with speed and ambition to diversify our trade partners and build our strength here at home.
title: Canada announces provisional safeguard tariff on imports of canned vegetables to protect Canadian producers
